operations.operation: InstallM2.5x3.75 Helicoil and remove its driving tang in a robot actuator shell
operations.procedure_read: Full source text: use specified Helicoil tap, insertion tool and tang-break-off tool; stop tap at rising bottom resistance because printed threads strip easily; install fourM2.5x3.75mm coils and remove tangs, ensuring none stay inside part.
operations.reason: Distinct thread-insert formation/tang removal, no exact helicoil PR hit, but helically elastic wire and fracture are essential; not a rigid ordinary-screw model. Tiny coil/tool contacts and thread geometry not source-dimensioned; three-tool manipulation plus tang collection requires costly mechanism proof. Merely declaring latched insert/removed tang from turn count would be invalid. Do not promote to satisfy quota.
operations.cheapest_falsifier: Obtain exact coil/tool contact geometry and verify stock tool grasp plus causal insertion/tang fracture before full simulation.
operations.competitor_query: queries-rigid-final.json helicoil0hits; thread-insert finds#1212 heat-set insert, a thermal embed mechanism.0hits is not exhaustive novelty proof.

operations.operation: Press-fit an ODRI compound pulley using actual matched toothed profiles
operations.procedure_read: Full source text: apply Loctite648 to printed internal tooth profile, align aluminium pulley tooth pattern/centering hole, use published protection/assembly tools and arbor press or vise; finish flush and remove excess adhesive/scraped material.
operations.reason: Source-rich genuine robot manufacturing step; not belt winding. However press-fit forming plus adhesive cure/retention, tiny toothed profiles and press tool reaction add source/physics cost. Similar generic bearing/shaft pressing family; no exceptional novelty/stock-YAM proof established in bounded pass.
